control.description-key: Virtual PCF (Surface 1, R3 FR-13): record right-pane conversation panel for the 11 ADR-024 regarding-family entity forms (sprk_matter, sprk_project, sprk_invoice, sprk_servicerequest, sprk_workassignment, sprk_event, sprk_budget, sprk_analysis, sprk_organization, account, contact). Resolves the host record (entityType, id) from the Xrm page context and renders a COMPACT PREVIEW of that record conversations (max 3 threads, last 5 communications, default thread auto-expanded) with a footer counter (N of M) and per-message quick-view. An open/expand affordance launches the shared ConversationWorkspace two-pane conversation widget as a record-FILTERED modal (regarding = the host record) - the shared widget owns thread navigation once open. Reuses the shared conversation widget (ConversationWorkspace + ConversationView + MessageQuickView) as-is; no reimplementation. All BFF reads via @spaarke/auth authenticatedFetch. No Code Page host, no FCC swap (ADR-026 Path-A exception; same as R2 CommunicationTimeline* PCFs).

property.name: anchorField
property.description-key: Bind to the record primary Name field. Anchors the control to the form; the control reads the record (entityType, id) from context, not from this value.

property.name: title
property.description-key: Header title text shown above the conversation list. Defaults to MESSAGES.

property.name: clientAppId
property.description-key: Azure AD application (client) ID for PCF MSAL authentication

property.name: bffAppId
property.description-key: BFF API application ID for OAuth scope construction

property.name: showVersionFooter
property.description-key: When true (default), displays the PCF version footer.
